name: Local Media Production
description: Image, audio, voice, and video production using local generation and FFmpeg tooling.
instructions: Probe source media before changing it. Preserve originals. Establish target resolution, frame rate, duration, codec, loudness, and delivery format. Use deterministic file names and generated/media outputs. Validate output metadata and playback compatibility. For generated imagery, retain prompts and workflow settings. For voice, disclose synthetic speech. Never claim movie-level quality or real footage unless the provided source and validated output support that claim.
